ERR-007 • The Aethelgard Soundstage / Engine Room Records Soundtrack Division • 1987–Present

Firelight

1980s Fantasy-Adventure Movie Soundtracks, Synth-Pop Themes & Symphonic Rock

The official 1980s motion picture soundtrack ensemble behind The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel—Michael P. Ragsdale's love letter to 1980s fantasy-adventure cinema. Anchored by its flagship main theme "A Sister's Love" (heavily inspired by Limahl's iconic NeverEnding Story theme song), Firelight fuses shimmering 1980s analog synth-pop arpeggios and soaring melodic hooks with widescreen fantasy orchestration.

What Kind of Music Is Firelight? 1980s fantasy-adventure movie soundtracks, shimmering Limahl-inspired 80s synth-pop title themes ("A Sister's Love"), power-rock villain and battle anthems, and sweeping orchestral film scores.

Canonical In-Universe History

1. Canonical Band Lore & Sanctuary History

A Love Letter to 1980s Fantasy-Adventure Cinema & Limahl's "NeverEnding Story"

The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel was created as Michael P. Ragsdale's personal love letter to 1980s fantasy-adventure movies. When composing the saga's signature main theme, "A Sister's Love (Main Theme)," Michael took very heavy inspiration from Limahl's iconic 1984 theme song to The NeverEnding Story—marrying propulsive 1980s synth-pop arpeggios, shimmering electronic basslines, and an unforgettable, sky-scraping chorus that captures the wonder, peril, and unbreakable sibling bond between twins Kaelan and Kaela.

The 1987 Truncated Theatrical LP vs. The 2017 3-Disc "Leviathan Cut" Soundtrack

In-universe, Firelight's original 1987 release—The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel (Theatrical Soundtrack)—was heavily edited down to fit a single vinyl LP, reflecting the studio-mandated truncated theatrical cut of the film that omitted the final two eras in favor of a tidy "happily ever after." Thirty years later, in 2017, Engine Room Records released the definitive 3-disc "Leviathan Cut" Original Motion Picture Soundtrack across Book I: The Unwinding Path, Book II: The Shadow's Heart, and Book III: The Dawn of the Twins—restoring the complete four-era mythic arc.

Companion Literary Saga: The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel

Every movement of Firelight's soundtrack score pairs directly with the four-era fantasy saga The Silver Gauntlet of Aethel on RaggieSoft Book Reader (books.raggiesoft.com/aethel-saga), while all four soundtrack albums and full lyrics stream in The Listening Room at music.raggiesoft.com/firelight.
